description: Schema-like structure for future public-safe research into official live broadcast and replay availability. Records are intentionally empty until jurisdiction research is completed from official or clearly official-partner sources.

record_fields.jurisdiction_id: Stable lowercase identifier for the jurisdiction or racing authority.
record_fields.country_or_region: Country, territory, state, province, or region covered by the record.
record_fields.racing_types: Array of racing types covered by the record, such as horse racing, harness racing, greyhound racing, or camel racing.
record_fields.live_status: Approved status value describing live broadcast availability.
record_fields.replay_status: Approved status value describing replay or archive availability.
record_fields.provider_name: Official authority, venue, event, broadcaster, streaming partner, or null when not verified.
record_fields.official_live_url: Official live information URL, or null when not verified or not available.
record_fields.official_replay_url: Official replay information URL, or null when not verified or not available.
record_fields.requires_login: Boolean indicating whether official access requires a non-betting login.
record_fields.requires_betting_account: Boolean indicating whether official access requires a betting or wagering account.
record_fields.requires_paid_tv: Boolean indicating whether official access requires paid TV or an equivalent paid broadcast package.
record_fields.geo_restriction: Neutral summary of stated geographic limits, or null when none are verified.
record_fields.source_type: Official source type from the allowed source list.
record_fields.evidence_urls: Array of official or clearly official-partner URLs used as evidence.
record_fields.confidence: Confidence value based on the clarity and recency of official evidence.
record_fields.last_checked: ISO 8601 date when the official evidence was reviewed.
record_fields.notes: Concise neutral notes about access limitations, uncertainty, or research scope.
